patterns: APPSC asks bare Article numbers: tenure Art. 56, removal Art. 61, pardon Art. 72; and electoral-college composition as an A-E statement list (key A, C, E).
Recurring trap: who votes vs who impeaches (MLAs elect but don't impeach; nominated MPs impeach but don't elect); CM in Legislative Council cannot vote.
Pardon: 'only the President can pardon a death sentence' (Governor can only commute/remit); suspensive veto not for Money Bills.
AP tilt: N. Sanjiva Reddy - only unopposed President, ex-Speaker, first AP CM; Epuru Sudhakar case.
App MCQs are mostly multi-statement items on fine procedure (vote-value formula, Art. 240 UTs, appointment Articles); PYQs are mainly one-line Article/fact recall.
